name: Prone Scorpion
steps: Lie facedown on the floor with both arms extended straight out to your sides in a T and palms pressed down.
Bend one knee, lift that thigh slightly off the floor, and rotate your pelvis smoothly to reach that foot toward your opposite hand.
Pause briefly as you feel a controlled stretch across your hip, chest, and spine, keeping your chest resting close to the floor.
Return your leg smoothly to the start and alternate sides cleanly for the target duration.
tips: Keep both shoulders and palms anchored toward the floor rather than rolling completely onto your side.
Move smoothly through a comfortable range instead of whipping your leg aggressively across.
